target.statement: Mean ROC-AUC of the kth-NN algorithm across all 49 datasets (after excluding 3) is 0.769, as reported in the 'Mean AUC' column of Table 3.
target.dataset: 49 real-world multivariate tabular datasets (from ODDS, ADBench, ELKI, etc.)

compute.basis: The target requires running kth-NN (a simple distance-based method) on 49 datasets, many of which are small to medium (largest ~286k samples). The code and data are provided, but the full pipeline includes data loading, preprocessing, and evaluation across all datasets; on a CPU laptop this is feasible but may take a few hours due to the number of datasets and hyperparameter settings (k=5..30).

title: Unsupervised anomaly detection algorithms on real-world data: how many do we need?
